|translation='''Title:''' Atgar laser cannon.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on an exterior planet site. Cannot be moved. Your warrior at the same location may fire at a target at the same or an adjacent location, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle crashes if destiny +2 > armor. A vehicle is hit if destiny +1 > maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
Atgar 1.4 FD P-tower, an anti-vehicle cannon. After modification, its performance hardly falls even in extreme cold.
